body:
Finite complex-supplier circuit construction; **no new kappa**. Deferring negations inside same-frame helper runs, then paying every boundary restoration, saves **224 real primitives per orientation** of the historical PR626 CK word after accepted PR696 lowering.

| Complete scalar projection | PR696 | Replacement |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Forward | 169,618 | 169,394 |
| Backward / inverse transpose | 169,634 | 169,410 |

The complete census checks 2,219 runs per orientation. Fourteen nonzero-frame helper runs each save 16 real primitives; 2,205 have zero cost change. All source operations, coefficient preparation, copies, clears and boundary negations are charged. Paid children and non-scalar events are unchanged. This does not change the selected #799 result, whose conditional kappa remains 0.001661634653669567.

Reproduce offline, standard-library Python 3.9+:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/ck-sign-normalization-seed22/check.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CK_SIGN_PACKAGE runs=2219+2219 columns=725 saved=224/224 kappa=unchanged`.

The Fraction interpreter checks the complete scalar projections on 725 arbitrary input columns, every boundary, expected final shears, helper restoration and private clearing. A separately written integer-dyadic interpreter and event splitter check every run as a full arbitrary-input operator and every candidate prefix row modulo sign. Both stream hashes and counts agree. Scalar-projection row-l1 maxima remain 5120/4847 and fractional depths 3/8. These are finite scalar checks; physical frame/Clifford events are not executed by these interpreters.

Validation passes under isolated optimized CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6: 56 actual-run mutants, five toy adverse controls, boundary segmentation, copy-fanout cost growth, minimal relocation, gzip repackaging, source/receipt corruption and selected-record integrity. Package tests: `python3 -I -O -B research/ck-sign-normalization-seed22/test_package.py`. The generic proof explicitly accounts for cases where sign propagation increases cost; no universal savings or optimum is claimed.

Only `research/ck-sign-normalization-seed22/` is added, including proof, exact certificates, source pins, local claim, validation and AI disclosure. Base: **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**. OS assignment seed **22**, complex-supplier track. Refreshed main `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09` retains all four consumed input pins and the selected certificate. No pinned sprint issue existed.

The pre-submission refresh inspected 707 open PRs through #917. #807/#816/#917 change CK frame-zero compensation, #860 shares signed coefficient work, #750 relocates a cleanup scale, and #883/#916 concern selected-X4 preconditions/admission. This contribution instead normalizes signs in historical CK nonzero-frame helper runs. No pending code is imported and savings are not assumed additive.

Credit **Sagar Thakrar #696**, **icekylinx**, **Jeremy Kothe #622**, **Chafik Boukhalfa #626**, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Rohan Arun and the retained predecessor lineage. Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate arithmetic implementation and AI review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review is claimed.

Native physical admission, typed production integration, fresh global owner/invoice/assembly bindings, and inherited all-size/compiler/hosting/precision/tape/analytic obligations remain open. Full repository/cold supplier suites, Lean and hosted CI were not run. Finite circuit evidence is not a full multiplication theorem proof.
title: Finite construction: CK helper-run sign normalization saves 224 primitives per orientation (no new kappa)
